incident-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api-apac detected sustained queue growth — backlog=48,200 reqs, p95=18.3s, p99=49.1s, GPU pool apac-gpu-pool at 100% utilization. Auto-escalate to ops_pager.
ops_pager: paging @sara (oncall) — please acknowledge.
sara (oncall): I'm on it, looking at apac cluster now.
sara (oncall): Observing autoscaler failing to provision new GPU nodes: cloud API returning 429 and 'quotaExceeded'. Provisioner logs: "createInstance: throttled, backoff=exponential".
mike (infra): Confirming from infra side — project GPU quota in APAC exhausted. Also H100 spot returns 'noCapacity' for the past 8 minutes.
jasmine (eng-runtime): Runtime shows queuing spike because many requests hit long prefixes and KV-cache growth increased per-token work; batching windows widened and latency shot up. Can we route non-critical traffic to eu-west or dedicated pools?
sara (oncall): Action plan: 1) enable fallback routing to eu-west for paid tiers; 2) enable rate-shed for free tier; 3) attempt manual hot-pool creation in a region with spare quota. I'll coordinate.
deploy-bot: route-override canary rolled to 12% of traffic for model-family=gpt-ls-1.
kai (prod-sre): Autoscaler stuck in backoff due to repeated 429s — remediate by either increasing quota or by operator-triggered manual provisioning. Backoff prevents further create attempts.
mike (infra): I'm opening an emergency quota request with cloud provider (ticket #CLOUD-98721). Meanwhile I can provision 4 x v100-temp nodes in apac-legacy where we still have quota; will bind them to apac-gpu-pool as a temporary measure.
ashwin (cs): (typo) ashwin (cs): Notifying impacted customers now — starting with top-5 who have >5% error rate. Using status page template.
sara (oncall): Implement temporary token-level throttling: cap new tokens per-client to 30 r/s and enable 503 short-circuit for over-limit. This reduces effective inbound pressure.
jasmine (eng-runtime): Also flipping a quantization fallback for non-critical models: map requests to q8_0 variants to cut memory and increase concurrency. Rolling to 30% non-critical traffic.
mike (infra): Manual provisioning complete: 4 v100-temp nodes created, joined gpu-pool, kube nodes ready. Command used: `kubectl label nodes gpu-temp-0 gpu=true && kubectl apply -f apac-hotpool.yaml`
incident-bot: After manual nodes join — backlog down to 14,020, p95=5.2s, p99=13.6s. Error rate dropped from 7.8% to 2.1% overall.
ashwin (cs): Customer updates sent. Two major customers confirmed improved experience after reroute, one still seeing intermittent timeouts (we flagged support ticket).
sara (oncall): Keep fallback routing at 25% for paid tiers; keep free-tier throttling enabled. Leave autoscaler disabled for auto-provision in APAC until quota response or reserved capacity confirmed. Postmortem owner: kai (prod-sre).
kai (prod-sre): I'll own postmortem and runbook updates. Initial hypothesis: simultaneous marketing campaign spike + cloud GPU quota exhaustion + spot capacity loss triggered autoscaler backoff and manual provisioning gap. Need clearer circuit breaker and operator alert when autoscaler hits quota 429s.
mike (infra): Action: request reserved GPUs for critical pools and add cloud quota monitor that alerts before hard exhaustion. Also add logic to skip exponential backoff for 429 quota errors and instead escalate immediately to oncall.
jasmine (eng-runtime): Add runtime fast-fail path: if queue depth > 30k for >2m, reject long-tail requests earlier with structured error recommending retry-after header. This prevents amplification of batching windows.
sara (oncall): Good. For now we consider paging mitigated — keep watch for 2hrs. Thanks all. I'll hand back to oncall watch.
incident-bot: Pager cleared at 1769901800 by sara (oncall). Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.
